source: The first half of the handbook explains the machine. The second half explains why common performance numbers can disagree. That separation is deliberate: architecture describes what resources exist; performance analysis asks which of those resources actually limited a particular workload.
zh: 手册的前半部分解释了机器。后半部分解释了为什么常见的性能数据可能不一致。这种分离是经过深思熟虑的：架构描述了存在的资源；性能分析询问哪些资源实际上限制了特定的工作负载。
